Empyrean Design Studio
Advertiser: Empyrean Design Studio
Started: 6 Apr 2026
Ready to grow your design career without giving up a stable
income? Empyrean Design Studio is hiring Interior Designers
with a compensation model that's first of its kind in
Singapore — a fixed salary plus commission on every project
you close. No more pure-commission stress. No more income
uncertainty. Just great design work, backed by a team that
feels like family. Whether you're experienced or hungry to
learn, if you've got the eye and the drive, we want to hear
from you. Apply today and join one of SG's fastest-growing
